subject: accordion-bodied duck automaton
art_direction: 旧铁皮鸭肚子是短风琴，青铜铆钉和珊瑚漆，嘴巴闭合、神态端正。
composition: one original central subject with a clear silhouette and circular-crop safe focal point
creative_direction: Build a collectible duck automaton from painted tin, with a short paper accordion forming its belly. Its closed beak, small round head, and low hanging wings give it a formal, almost pompous posture. Extend one webbed foot forward as if beginning a tiny march. Use coral enamel, oxidized teal panels, and a few brass rivets. Photograph it against a deep blue-gray field, with gentle wear revealing metal at the edges. Keep the mechanism decorative and compact, with no key protruding like a weapon, labels, or factory logos. Square 1024x1024. Keep the complete central silhouette within a circular crop, occupying about 70% of the canvas. Original design; no lettering, logos, or watermark.
style_inspiration: Entirely original text-only concept, no IP characters, copied artwork, celebrity likeness or named artist imitation.
visual_review: passed: compressed preview inspected for distinct original concept, appealing silhouette and expression, requested medium, coherent shape/anatomy, clean visual hierarchy, no text or watermark
